command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$keep=@("main","control/remote-shell")
$delete=@(
  "docs/current-packaging-acceptance-20261005",
  "docs/current-provenance-snapshot-20261005",
  "work/current-release-packaging-20261005",
  "work/current-release-packaging-final-20261005",
  "work/current-release-packaging-validated-20261005",
  "work/diagnostic-evidence-skip-20261005",
  "work/diagnostic-skip-evidence-policy-20261005",
  "work/remote-evidence-api-fix-20261005",
  "work/remote-evidence-fetch-fix-20261005",
  "work/remote-evidence-redirect-fix-20261005",
  "work/remote-failure-powershell-classify-20261005",
  "work/remote-retry-evidence-20261005",
  "work/remote-reusable-artifacts-20261005",
  "work/verification-infra-hardening-20261005",
  "work/verification-infra-simplify-20261005"
)
Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE
$remote=(git remote get-url origin).Trim()
Write-Host "BRANCH_CLEANUP_REMOTE=$remote"
foreach($branch in $delete){
  if($branch -in $keep){throw "refusing to delete protected operational branch: $branch"}
  $exists=& git ls-remote --heads origin "refs/heads/$branch"
  if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(($exists -join ""))){
    Write-Host "BRANCH_ALREADY_ABSENT=$branch"
    continue
  }
  & git push origin --delete $branch
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "failed to delete branch: $branch"}
  Write-Host "BRANCH_DELETED=$branch"
}
foreach($branch in $keep){
  $exists=& git ls-remote --heads origin "refs/heads/$branch"
  if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(($exists -join ""))){throw "required branch missing after cleanup: $branch"}
  Write-Host "BRANCH_KEPT=$branch"
}
Write-Host "BRANCH_CLEANUP_PASS"
